reviews.comment: She's incredibly rude and once called me out on the grading rubric for a group project. I talked to her after class by myself about dates for our final and last class day and was so rude by giving me attitude and asked me sarcastic questions like if I was a new student in the class and if I had taken the midterm before. Meanest professor I've had.

Does not always give students participation points when they show up and speak/participate in class - gives 0s. When you email her about why you got a 0 for participating she will be upset about it. Never gives clear instructions for grading criteria. Spends most of class trying to get her computer working. Always teaches overtime in class.

She's nice and she enjoys what she does, but she's pretty monotone and dull,. The class is fun when she makes it conversational, but boring when she's just talking. There's a lot of readings and they're pretty important to do well on the exam. Class isn't hard just takes time. I'd recommend taking someone more enthusiastic.

P. Thornton is one of the most respected professors I have ever had, from myself and the entrepreneurial community across America. She teaches real world entr., and you can take these principles straight to your business or idea. Her knowledge goes beyond a textbook, and she cares for your success as much as you care for her class. Remember that.

Grades based on group projects. SLOW GRADER-posted project 1 grade beginning of Sep and didnt post another until after I asked- in December! Was very rude when I contacted a/b grades. Posted the remaining 4 projects and midterm grades 2 days b/f the final. no rubric for 2 projects but graded harshly. Tests are a joke. she just seemed a lil clueless

Professor Thornton's class is a bit confusing. You sign up for a seminar, in which you work on projects to invite entrepreneurs to class and they share their experiences. It's a great idea for a class! However, at times she takes over THEIR presentation and it throws them off. Lectures are real heavy and you have to have your camera on for credit.
